rationale: The broad market environment has grown even more bearish since entry (SPY down to -2.73%, VIXY up to +6.64%), supporting the downside continuation thesis. Although SKM bounced off the $27.32 session low (0.86% MFE), the current 1-minute bounce to $27.51 occurs on low volume and remains underneath the descending 5-minute 9-EMA ($27.54) and session VWAP ($28.02).
